sections.title: I. Largo maestoso ed espressivo (The Shadow of Grief)
sections.character: Grave, noble Chopin recitative; solitary bell strike, Neapolitan sixth, and weeping Ur-Motif

sections.title: II. Andante cantabile con dolore (The Memory of Lost Love)
sections.character: Noble, singing Chopin/Kreisler cantabile theme with ABBA circular descending fate & Lisztian inner polyphony

sections.title: III. Poco a poco accelerando ed agitato (The Flight of Icarus)
sections.character: Surging, crystalline 16th-note wave arpeggios soaring towards the blinding heavens

sections.title: IV. Grandioso e disperato (The Climax & The Fall)
sections.character: Fortissimo tragic catharsis in orchestral octaves, followed by the catastrophic 7-octave plummet

sections.title: V. Adagio lacrimoso e smorzando (Whisper Codetta & Far Farewell)
sections.character: Una corda silence, water-drop arpeggios, high music-box sighs, and fragile Picardy dissolution
